"CONTENT" : "UNKNOWN"; } function getWafState() { try { var state = cache.get(IEEE_WAF_STATE); return state == null ? "" : String(state); } catch (e) { return ""; } } function putWafState(state, ttl) { try { cache.put(IEEE_WAF_STATE, state, ttl || IEEE_WAF_TTL); } catch (e) {} } function fetchIeeeWebView() { var url = String(baseUrl || ""); if (!/,\s*\{/.test(url)) { url += ',{"webView":true,"webViewDelayTime":6000}'; } try { var body = java.ajax(url); return body == null ? "" : String(body); } catch (e) { java.log("IEEE WebView 重取失败: " + e); return ""; } } function waitForWafOwner() { // Only one visible verification browser is allowed; other cache workers wait // for its shared result and then fetch their own chapter through WebView. for (var i = 0; i < 240; i++) { var state = getWafState(); if (state !== "pending") return state; try { Packages.java.lang.Thread.sleep(500); } catch (e) { return state; } } return getWafState(); } function deferWafVerification(content) { var current = content == null ? "" : String(content); var state = getWafState(); if (classifyIeeeResponse(current) === "CONTENT") return current; if (state === "pending") { state = waitForWafOwner(); } if (state === "verified") { var refreshed = fetchIeeeWebView(); if (classifyIeeeResponse(refreshed) === "CONTENT") return refreshed; putWafState("pending", 300); } else if (state === "blocked") { putWafState("pending", 300); } else if (state !== "pending") { putWafState("pending", 300); } state = getWafState(); if (state !== "pending") { var afterWait = waitForWafOwner(); if (afterWait === "verified") { var afterRefresh = fetchIeeeWebView(); if (classifyIeeeResponse(afterRefresh) === "CONTENT") return afterRefresh; } } try { java.log("IEEE WAF challenge：请在弹出的浏览器中打开文章 URL，正文加载后点击确认"); var response = java.startBrowserAwait(baseUrl, "IEEE WAF 验证", false); var verified = response == null ? "" : String(response.body() || ""); if (classifyIeeeResponse(verified) === "CONTENT") { putWafState("verified", IEEE_WAF_TTL); java.log("IEEE WAF 验证成功，继续下载队列"); return verified; } putWafState("blocked", 30); java.log("IEEE WAF 验证后仍未取得正文，本章交给缓存重试"); } catch (e) { putWafState("blocked", 30); java.log("IEEE WAF 验证失败，本章交给缓存重试: " + e); } return ""; } result = deferWafVerification(result); result; @css:h1.document-title, div.toc-container, div.abstract-text, div.document-text@html function prepareContent(html) { html = html == null ? "" : String(html); var extract_selector = ['.inline-formula','disp-formula']; var Jsoup = org.jsoup.Jsoup; var doc = Jsoup.parse(html); // ---------- 0. ★ 公式转图片：基于DOM读取 webJs 阶段写入的 data-original-tex 属性 ---------- function extractMiText(el){ var mis = el.select('span.mi'); if (mis.size() == 0) { // disp-formula 因HTML5解析被拆散：MathJax_Display 变成了父

的下一个兄弟节点 var parent = el.parent(); var sib = parent ? parent.nextElementSibling() : null; if (sib && sib.hasClass('MathJax_Display')) { mis = sib.select('span.mi'); sib.remove(); // ★ 提取完文本后必须删除这个孤立的渲染节点，否则会残留一大段无意义的MathJax内部span标记混入正文 } } var miText = ''; for (var j = 0; j < mis.size(); j++){ var t = String(mis.get(j).text()).trim(); if (t) miText += (miText ? ' ' : '') + t; } return miText; } function formulaSpeech(tex, java, cache){ var cacheKey = 'codecogs_speech:' + tex; var cached = cache.get(cacheKey); if (cached != null) return String(cached); try { var response = java.ajax('https://latex.codecogs.com/mathml.latex?' + encodeURIComponent(tex)); var speechDoc = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(String(response || '')); var speech = String(speechDoc.select('span.cc-speech').text()).trim(); if (speech) cache.put(cacheKey, speech, 2592000); return speech; } catch (e) { java.log('公式朗读文本获取失败: ' + e); return ''; } } function formulaToImage(doc){ var formulas = doc.select('disp-formula, inline-formula'); for (var i = 0; i < formulas.size(); i++){ var el = formulas.get(i); try { var preview = el.select('tex-math').first(); var tex = preview ? String(preview.text()).trim() : ''; if (!tex) { var source = el.select('span.tex.tex2jax_ignore').first(); tex = source ? String(source.text()).trim() : ''; } if (!tex) continue; // 未保留公式源码时，交给下面 extract_selector 兜底转纯文本 var miText = extractMiText(el); var speechText = formulaSpeech(tex, java, cache); var imgUrl = 'https://latex.codecogs.com/svg.latex?' + encodeURIComponent(tex); var imgEl = doc.createElement('img'); imgEl.attr('src', imgUrl); el.replaceWith(imgEl); //java.log("formula:"+tex+"->"+imgUrl) if (speechText || miText) { var spanEl = doc.createElement('span'); //spanEl.addClass('notranslate'); spanEl.text(' ' + (speechText || miText) + ' '); imgEl.after(spanEl); } } catch (e) { java.log('公式转图片失败: ' + e); } } // ★ 兜底清理：以防某些 MathJax_Display 没有被上面的 extractMiText 正确摘除 // (例如结构异常/多层嵌套)，统一在最后再清一遍，避免残留大段MathJax内部渲染标记。 doc.select('div.MathJax_Display').remove(); } formulaToImage(doc); // ---------- 2. 原有清理逻辑（保持）---------- remove_selector && remove_selector.forEach(function(css){ // ★ 修复:原是 remove_selector 未定义会报错 doc.select(css).forEach(function(el){ el.remove(); }); }); doc.select("a:has(img[loading='lazy'])").forEach(function(element){ var img = element.select("img").first(); if (img) { var aHref = element.attr("href"); if (aHref) { var src = aHref + ',{"webView":true}'; img.attr("src", src); } } }); doc.select("img[src]").forEach(function(img){ var attributes = img.attributes().iterator(); while (attributes.hasNext()) { var attr = attributes.next(); if (attr.getKey() != "src") { attributes.remove(); } } }); function replaceElementsWithText(selectors){ selectors.forEach(function(selector){ doc.select(selector).forEach(function(element){ var clone = element.clone(); clone.select("script").remove(); var textNode = new org.jsoup.nodes.TextNode(clone.text().replace(' ','')); element.replaceWith(textNode); }); }); } replaceElementsWithText(extract_selector); // ---------- 3. 翻译清理后的 HTML 文本节点 ---------- return TC(doc.html(), java, cache); } if (result !== "") { result = prepareContent(result); } result;
